description:
A nice church bell in a village. 
I made this recording in Rennes le chateau, a village located in the Pyrénées, in the south-west of France. 
At the beginning of the file, you can hear a fountain in a small square, while some people are talking and passing by. Then, at 1’40’’, the bell of the church nearby will ring 5 times. Tow minutes later, it will ring 5 times again. (Sorry for the slight wind you can hear from time to time...) 
Recorded in August 2019 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Rode Stereo videomic X (SVMX). 
Fade in/out applied in Audacity.
